extraction.notes: EQR reports no AFFO metric; affo fields are null. Starting line is net income; the FFO subtotal used is 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (340,911), which is after preferred distributions (-356). The preferred distributions line is therefore placed in ffo_adjustments with category 'other' so the subtotal ties. The printed 'FFO' line before preferred is 341,267 and 'Normalized FFO' before preferred is 381,448; both are shown in the source but not used as subtotals here. Depreciation of Partially Owned Properties (-616) and the NCI share (-1,069) are deducted as noncontrolling interest items. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (416) was categorized as 'other' since its underlying asset type is not specified. 'Other miscellaneous items' (38,811) is large for the quarter and is categorized 'other' as printed. Diluted shares 385,108 (thousands) reproduces $0.89 FFO and $0.99 Normalized FFO per share (340,911/385,108 and 381,092/385,108). Recurring capex of $35,580 (total consolidated, quarter) is from the Residential Capital Expenditures table on page 22; the same-store figure is $32,068. Non-residential capex (~$3.4 million) was not included.
